updates.detailed_summary_zh: BitMEX于8月26日开始分阶段关闭，进入仅减仓模式，强制在9月23日前平仓所有未平仓头寸。届时交易结束，余额将转入钱包。
updates.detailed_summary_en: BitMEX begins its staged shutdown on Aug. 26 with reduce-only mode, forcing open positions closed by Sept. 23 as trading ends and balances move to wallets.
